column1: # The Olde English Folio: archaic words (Crossword.Core.Lexicon.Dictionaries), hand-written for this game.
# Line format: WORD<TAB>gloss. '#' comments and blank lines are ignored.
# A theme dictionary: ENABLE already has nearly every familiar archaic word, so instead of adding words it gives
# bonus Mult for each of these words a play forms (DictionaryDefinition.ThemeMult). The few that aren't ENABLE words
# (crossword contractions like OER for o'er, and OLDE) also become legal. Rules (tests enforce the first two): A-Z
# only, 3-7 letters (2-letter YE would be too easy to farm; longer words can't fit the 7x7 board); every entry has a
# gloss. Content: words whose main sense is archaic; words still in everyday use (ART, WILT, MINE, ALBEIT) are left
# out. Entries still go through the denylist.
